book.name: Efesus
book.title: Efesus Pas nda Por ai Efesusɨhündambo sürü papɨmarandɨ

content: Sɨhɨrɨ yɨfɨhündɨ nahuraimefa God ai yaŋgɨrɨ-mareamunɨ
Horombo se Godɨndɨ hoafɨ hɨmborɨkoate-yeihɨ, hohoanɨmo moaruwai süŋgurɨhi marɨhündɨ, ranɨyei se yɨfɨhündɨ nahurai-mayei.

Rasɨmboa se ndanɨ hɨfɨnɨndɨ moaruwai hohoanɨmo ra süŋgurɨhindühɨ, asu moaruwai nendɨ nɨmoamo sünambe amarei ahei bogorɨndɨ hoafɨ süŋgurɨhi marɨhündɨ. Asu haponda ai Godɨndɨ hoafɨ hɨmborɨkoate-yeimbɨ muŋgu hɨfandarandürɨ.

Horombo sɨhɨrɨ amboanɨ ai ramehindɨ nahurai-mayefɨ. Sɨhɨrɨ sɨhefɨ hɨfɨnɨndɨ hohoanɨmo süŋgurɨhundühɨ asu nɨnɨ-moatükunɨ sɨhefɨ fiambe hohoanɨmo yifirayo ra rarɨhu süŋgurɨhu marɨhundɨ. Asu bodɨmondambo ramefeyo nou, sɨhefɨmbo amboa God ai ŋgɨnɨndɨ-ndamunühɨ tɨŋɨrɨfo mbɨsayamun-amboane.

Yɨnɨ, ro Godɨndɨ hoafɨ hɨmborɨkoate-yefühɨ yɨfɨhündɨ nahurai-yefɨ, ŋga Godɨndɨ moanɨ hɨpoambofe ra adükarɨ hamɨnd-ane asu ai sɨhefɨmbo afɨndɨ ŋgusüfo pareamunühɨ Krais-babɨdɨ yaŋgɨrɨ-mareamunɨ. Ahandɨ moanɨ hɨpoambo-nambo yaŋgɨrɨ sɨhefɨmbo farɨhemunühɨ aboedambo-mareamunɨ.
Asu sɨhefɨmbo Krais-babɨdɨ yaŋgɨreamunühɨ sünambe nɨmoamo hɨnɨŋgɨ-mareamuna, ai-babɨdɨmbo bogorɨndɨ fondɨhü amarefɨ.
Ai afɨndɨ hamɨndɨ moanɨ hɨpoambo-reamunühɨ Kraisɨndɨ süŋguyo sɨhefɨmbo aboedɨ hohoanɨmomemunɨ. Ra koadürümbo-koadürümbo süŋgunambo nafuimbohünda Krais-babɨdɨ ahandɨ fondɨhü nɨmoamo hɨnɨŋgɨmareamunɨ.
Se anɨhondümbo-marɨhind-amboyu asu God ai ahandɨ hɨpoambofena aboedambo-mareandürɨ. God ai moanɨ masagadür-ane sɨheimbo, ŋga sɨheihoarɨ moai ranɨ-moatükunɨ ra rarɨhindɨ.
God ai moai se aboedɨ ratüpurɨ ramarɨhindɨ ranɨmbo hohoanɨmoyuhü aboedambo-reandürɨ. Ranɨmayo-wamboane, asu ŋgɨrɨ se sɨheihoarɨ ranɨmbo borɨndei.

Sɨhefɨmbo nafɨramunühɨ asu Krais-babɨdɨ mamambereamunühɨ, aboedɨ hohoanɨmo süŋgufembo-hündambo nafɨmaramun-anefɨ. Horombo God ai aboedɨ hohoanɨmo ra hohoanɨmoyu masɨhend-ane, sɨhɨrɨ rasüŋgufembo-hündambo.
Krais ai Suda-yei ndɨfo aheimbo mamühɨmarearü

Ranɨmboane asu se ndanahambo hohoanɨmondei. Suda ai ahamundɨ warɨna fi-hoearɨ karu tɨrɨhoemo arundɨ. Ŋga seana Suda-yafe ndɨfo-anei asu moai sɨhamundɨ fi-hoearɨ karu tɨrɨhoemo rundɨ. Asu Suda ai sɨheimbo sɨsɨndɨ hoafɨrundürühɨ seiya fi-hoearɨ kefe tɨrɨhefe-koateyomo-rundeimb-anemo sei dükamarɨhipurɨ.

Se ndanahambo hohoanɨmondei. Horombo se Krais-babɨdɨ moai nɨboadei. Se nindou amur-anei, ŋga se nindou God ai dɨbonɨyu hɨnɨŋgɨ-mareandürɨ ranɨyei-poanɨ. God ai Sudambo horombo hoafɨmareandürɨ rasüŋgumbo aheimbo hoafɨ fɨramündü masɨhendɨ, ŋga sɨheimbo-ana, wanɨ. Se hɨfɨ ndanɨhü ana Godɨ-koate-ayei asu God sɨheimbo farɨhefe-ndürɨmboayu moai hɨfandühɨ nɨmarei.
Horombo se Godɨndɨ fikɨmɨ moai nɨmboei, ŋga haponda God ai sɨheimbo, Sisas Kraisɨndɨ horɨ ranɨnambo, ai-babɨdɨ mamambe-mareandüra, Godɨndɨ fikɨmɨ anɨmboei.

Krais ai Suda, asu Suda-yafe ndɨfo mamambe-reamunühɨ, sɨhefɨmbo wudɨmbohünda mafarɨhemunɨ. Horombo sɨmborɨ ŋgɨnɨndürɨyefühɨ nɨmboefɨmbo asu sɨmborɨ yiboaruko-firɨyefühɨ ranɨ-moatükunɨ ra ginɨrɨ nou mbusümo mapaiaro. Krais ai sɨmborɨ ŋgɨnɨndürɨ ra mbusümo kɨkɨmareandɨ.

Suda-yafe ahɨnümbɨ ai yowanɨ yahomo asu randɨhindɨ yahomo marundɨ, ŋga Krais yɨfɨmayu ranɨnambo ahɨnümbɨ hohoanɨmo ra awamarɨhoayo. Suda asu Suda-yafe ndɨfo ai-babɨdɨ mamambefe-pɨrɨmbo, sɨmborɨ nindou mamɨ nahurai tüküfembohünda Krais yɨfɨmayua, asu yimbu ai wudɨmayei.
Ahei sɨmborɨ ŋgɨnɨndürɨ kɨkɨfembohünda, asu yimbu mamambefepɨrɨ sepɨrɨmɨndɨ God sowana hombohünda, ai nɨmɨ keimbɨ karɨhendeimbɨfihɨ yɨfɨmayu.

Suda ai Godɨndɨ fikɨmɨ manɨmboei, ŋga Suda-yafe ndɨfo se ahandɨ fikɨmɨ aŋgunɨ manɨmboei, ŋga Krais ai kusü yimbu ranahafembo yahuya, ‘Se God-dɨbo wudɨndafɨneandühɨ asu sɨheihoarɨ amboa wudɨndei ndɨhündɨ,’ mehu
Kraisɨndɨ süŋguyo ro Suda, asu se Suda-yafe ndɨfo Godɨndɨ Yifiafɨ Aboedɨ ranɨnambo nafɨ masɨhemunambo wambo asu sɨhɨrɨ Ape sowana hefɨ arɨhundɨ.
Ranɨmboane asu hapondanɨ ana Suda-yafe ndɨfo se Godɨndɨ hɨmboahü nindou ranɨ-poanɨmbo asu amurɨ-yeipoanɨ, ŋga moanɨ se Godɨndɨ nindou yaŋgɨr-anei asu se muŋguambo ahandɨ fikɨmɨnɨndɨ yaŋgɨr-anei.
Se Godɨndɨ worɨ nahura-anei. Godɨndɨ hoafɨ hoafɨyomo-rundeimbɨ, asu Kraisɨndɨ hoafɨ sowandümo homo-rundeimbɨ ai hawesafɨ nahurai-anemo, asu Sisas Krais ai bogɨmondɨ nahurai-ani.
Krais ai nɨmɨ muŋgu ra mamambemareanda ŋgɨnɨndɨ manɨŋgo. God ai worɨ ra worɨmbo-randühani adükarɨ tükündɨfewanɨ asu Adükarɨ ai wandɨ yaŋgɨr-ane mbüsümbui.
God ai sɨheimbo amboa Kraisɨndɨ nendɨ asu Krais-babɨdɨ mamambe-reandürühɨ, ahandɨ Yifiafɨ ranambe nɨmarɨmbohünda worɨ ra worɨmboarandɨ.
